<function name="AddFrags" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Adds the provided amount to the player's frag/kill count.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="count" type="number">The amount to add.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Adds 2 frags to player</description>
	<code>Entity( 1 ):AddFrags( 2 )</code>
	<output>Player1 has 2 extra frags on the scoreboard relative to their old score.</output>

</example>
